routes.question: Can rooted-state coefficient geometry be shown to preserve unimodality under every tree composition?
routes.method: derive ratio/interlacing or synchronized-mode invariants closed under rooted composition
evidence: notes/referee_report.md: exact counterexamples to common-mode and naive cross-minor invariants
routes.next_test: seek an invariant strictly weaker than common gamma center and not implying a uniform cross-minor sign

routes.question: Can an exact counterexample be found outside the certified finite frontier?
routes.method: subtree mutation and grammar search with exact integer rooted DP, followed by independent edge-list verification
routes.next_test: any counterexample search must now start at order 32; the present endpoint is the exact order-31 finite theorem

routes.question: Which plausible closure lemmas already fail on small rooted trees?
routes.method: exact boundary, high-degree, path, star, subdivided-star, caterpillar and randomized tests
routes.failure_reason: common-mode and uniform adjacent cross-minor signs fail on exact rooted stars
routes.next_test: audit each new candidate invariant against the retained exact witnesses

routes.question: What is the smallest exact rooted-state representation that is complete for tree composition?
premises: rooted children form an unordered multiset
routes.method: canonical AHU encoding plus exact polynomial-pair DP
routes.next_test: add rooted AHU canonicalization only if a state-grammar proof route requires deduplication

routes.question: Can known non-log-concave tree constructions be parameter-amplified into a triple valley?
premises: source families to be verified in Gate 1
routes.method: symbolic independence polynomials in integer parameters and exact valley inequalities
evidence: Galvin family formula I=(C_t)^m+x(1+2x)^{tm} extracted from arXiv:2502.10654
routes.next_test: search exact products and root-coupled combinations of source families for a strict triple valley

routes.question: Does common-center gamma positivity give a composition-closed tree subclass?
premises: A_v and B_v lie in the same gamma cone for each rooted cell
routes.method: gamma-basis semiring closure and independent-set decomposition over a core tree
routes.failure_reason: not a new endpoint: double-private-leaf gamma positivity is explicit prior art and the broader gluing overlaps the 2026 bridge framework
routes.next_test: retain as a proof invariant and obstruction example, but make no novelty claim

routes.question: Are all unlabelled trees on exactly 31 vertices unimodal?
routes.method: frozen eight-worker exhaustive sweep, exact count aggregation, independent no-project-import reconstruction, and isolated source rebuild
routes.next_test: complete citation, manuscript, clean-build, and PDF audits before terminal release
